review.summary: Round 3 checks the round 2 fixes in da44b63 and rescans the whole branch. All three round 2 findings are fixed and nothing new was found. Following the new fix-loop wording in a scratch engine script resolves both an indirect dependency through a later organisation state and a derived metric that uses a failing timeserie's shortName. The example test now generates every timeseries skill spec, and it failed when a spec was changed to overflow. The skill tests, ruff and pyright pass, and no frontend file changed in this round. As in earlier rounds, the missing spec timeUnit check in the change-set engine predates this branch, and the claude.ai menu paths and the Claude Code end-to-end check are left to the manual verification.
